subject: MSA/Order Form: downstream vendor delegation — redline consolidation & approval gates
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@taloncloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed subcontractor addition + initial redlines

Hi Hannah / Kimberly,

As discussed in our onboarding call, TalonCloud is planning to route a subset of logging ingestion to a third-party processor (EdgeIngest LLC) to improve regional throughput. Attached is our proposed subprocessor notice and a tracked-change redline to the Order Form and MSA showing the delegation clauses we expect EdgeIngest to require.

Key asks from our side:
- Can Redwood confirm whether the proposed language in Section 3.2 (subcontracting) is acceptable or whether you need tighter audit / encryption wording?
- We will provide SOC attestation and data flow diagrams — is that sufficient for Redwood's DPA annex or do you need additional evidence?
- We are aiming for a sign-off window of 2 weeks to keep the deployment on track (target go-live 2026-12-06).

Attachments: TalonCloud_subproc_request_20261118.pdf (PDF), redlines_talon_20261118.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Procurement, TalonCloud
maya@taloncloud.com

- Procurement note: Connor, please flag any pricing/order-form impacts once legal confirms the scope.

I consolidated the two redline files you sent and uploaded a single file to our shared drive (link below). If we can get legal feedback within 3 business days we should be able to meet TalonCloud's sign-off window.

Next steps:
1) Kimberly: legal review & redline log (deliver by EOD 2026-11-20)
2) Connor: procurement review (pricing/approval gates)
3) Maya: upload SOC / network diagrams to the Drive link and confirm DocuSign readiness

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya@taloncloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:29:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subcontractor addition + initial redlines

Hi all — quick legal read and initial comments attached. High-level:

- Section 3.2 (Subcontracting): we need to clarify that any subprocessor will be bound by the DPA annex and subject to Redwood's audit rights. Suggest replacing the proposed phrase "equivalent obligations" with a more prescriptive list (encryption at rest AES-256, TLS1.3 in transit, data segregation controls, breach notification within 72 hours).
- Order Form impact: if EdgeIngest performs persistent storage for telemetry, we need to evaluate retention carveouts — procurement to confirm.
- Evidence: SOC2 Type II or ISO27001 certificate + network diagram + dataflow annotated to show redaction/encryption layers. A self-attestation alone is not sufficient for high-sensitivity customers.

I attached a marked-up PDF and inline comments in the consolidated redline. I will prepare a short DPA annex template that maps to their evidence buckets and share by EOD tomorrow (2026-11-21).

Attachment: KF_legal_comments_20261120.pdf (pdf)

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya@taloncloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subcontractor addition + initial redlines

Adding procurement perspective:

- Pricing: if EdgeIngest is performing additional retention or storage (beyond ephemeral buffering), we need to confirm whether there is a pass-through charge or minimum monthly commitment. Maya — can you confirm expected data volumes and any per-GB pricing?
- Approval gate: for Tier 2 subprocessors (processing telemetry but not PII), procurement + legal sign-off is fine. For Tier 1 (PII or customer-specific telemetry), we require a security review, SLA addendum, and executive approval.
- I've attached a quick approval matrix — please fill in the volume estimate column so I can map to the right approval path.

Attachment: procurement_matrix_20261121.csv (csv)

Connor O'Brien
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Maya Singh <maya@taloncloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T15:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subcontractor addition + initial redlines

Thanks everyone — answers inline and artifacts attached.

- EdgeIngest role: ephemeral ingestion + short-term persistence (30 days) for batching; not intended for long-term retention. We estimate ~2TB/month. No per-GB pass-through planned; covered under TalonCloud platform fees.
- Evidence: attaching EdgeIngest SOC2 Type II (pdf) and network/dataflow diagrams. They support AES-256 at rest and TLS1.3 in transit.
- DocuSign: TalonCloud can route the amended Order Form + DPA annex via DocuSign once Redwood provides the final DPA annex template. We referenced the HubSpot deal id in our system: DEAL-2026-0742.

Attachments: TalonCloud_SSAE18_20261125.pdf (pdf)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2026-0742

Looking forward to Kimberly's DPA annex and Hannah's confirmation of timeline.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Procurement, TalonCloud
maya@taloncloud.com
